_: Perturbation spec for scripts/tier_sensitivity.py, extracted mechanically from docs/tier_review_checklist.md (2026-07-09 review round). deciders = section-A tokens whose draft tier decides at least one flip call; blockers = section-B unclassified tokens that block flips. Scenarios bracket the vocabulary's decision space: exclude removes every flagged token from the vocabulary (its calls become uninformative); floor assigns them all tier 0 and ceiling tier 4, the two assignments most hostile to each direction of the asymmetry. Draft status mirrors data/urgency_tiers.draft.json.
